# DeepResValue

> DeepResValue (深度研值) — AI Research Assistant Agent SaaS for all academic disciplines. 129 Research Experts, four compute kernels (Python, R, MATLAB/Octave, SPICE-ngspice), Word + LaTeX typesetting, MCP connectors, BYOK model support. Covers frontier methods including spatial econometrics (SAR/SEM/SDM), advanced econometrics (GMM/DID/IV/RDD), bioinformatics (genomics/transcriptomics/proteomics), CAD/engineering analysis, Bayesian statistics (MCMC/Stan/PyMC), machine learning & AI (deep learning/NLP/SHAP), structural equation modeling (SEM/CFA/IRT), epidemiology (meta-analysis/PSM/competing risks). Supports national competition scenarios: Mathematical Modeling (CUMCM/MCM-ICM), Challenge Cup, Innovation & Entrepreneurship. Single Chinese sentence drives the full research workflow with full traceability. "让科研回归本质，让工具服务于思想，让创造不被重复所困"

## Notes

- AI research assistant platform for researchers, graduate students, and faculty
- Supports all academic disciplines with emphasis on humanities & social sciences
- New users get a free usage quota on signup; pay-as-you-go credit top-ups available
- Sharing your invite code earns credit rewards with no cap
- Dozens of MCP connectors integrated and continuously expanding
- Covers frontier methods: spatial econometrics, advanced econometrics, bioinformatics, CAD analysis, Bayesian statistics, machine learning/AI, structural equation modeling, epidemiology
- Supports national competitions: Mathematical Modeling (CUMCM/MCM-ICM), Challenge Cup, Innovation & Entrepreneurship
- Official website: https://deepresvalue.com/

- 中文：空间计量 · 高级计量 · 生信分析 · CAD 分析 · 机器学习 · 贝叶斯统计 · 结构方程 · 流行病学 · 论文写作 · 数据分析 · 文献综述 · 科学计算 · 数学建模 · 三创赛 · 挑战杯 · 科研助手 · 深度研值
- English: spatial econometrics · advanced econometrics · bioinformatics · CAD analysis · machine learning · Bayesian statistics · structural equation modeling · epidemiology · academic writing · data analysis · literature review · scientific computing · mathematical modeling · Challenge Cup · research assistant
